description.description: Description is free text for humans.

name.description: Name of the document, unique per kind.

SimulationAuth.description: SimulationAuth configures the credentials accepted by the simulator.

accept.description: Accept lists the accepted credentials. They are fake values by design.

loginResponse.description:
LoginResponse is a JSON fixture answered by the login endpoint, relative
to the sim/ directory; {token} and {expiresIn} (seconds) are replaced.
Default: {"token": "{token}", "expiresIn": {expiresIn}}.

tokenLifetime.description:
TokenLifetime of the tokens issued by the token and login endpoints,
in simulated time.

SimulationBasicCredential.description: SimulationBasicCredential is a username and password pair.

SimulationCredentials.description: SimulationCredentials are accepted credentials per auth type.

basic.description: Basic credentials accepted with auth type basic.

bearer.description: Bearer tokens accepted with auth type bearer.

clients.description:
Clients accepted by the token endpoint with auth type
oauth2_client_credentials.

header.description:
Header values accepted with auth type header, before the format of
the provider auth is applied.

logins.description:
Logins accepted by the login endpoint with auth type session_login:
the login body must carry both values.

plugin.description:
Plugin holds the credentials accepted by the simulator side of an
auth plugin (type plugin), read by the plugin.

SimulationInventory.description: SimulationInventory is a synthetic inventory: sets of items, each item under a parent item of another set.

seed.description:
Seed of the generated values. The same seed gives the same items and
the same dynamics.

sets.description: Sets of items, generated in order: a parent set comes first.

SimulationResponse.description: SimulationResponse is the response of a route.

itemsField.description:
ItemsField is the dotted path of the list a paginated route serves
page by page, inside an envelope; empty for a top-level array.

template.description:
Template is a Go text/template fixture rendering JSON, relative to
the sim/ directory (see docs/spec/08-simulator.md for its data and
helpers). Exactly one of file and template is set.

SimulationRoute.description: SimulationRoute is an endpoint of the simulator.

pagination.description:
Pagination serves the fixture items page by page. Its parameters come
from the job templates requesting this path, or from the provider.

path.description: Path of the route, relative to basePath, with {var} segments.

SimulationSet.description: SimulationSet is a set of generated items.

count.description: Count of items (per parent item when Parent is set).

name.description: Name of the set, used by the template helpers.

parent.description: Parent set: count items are generated under each of its items.

SimulationSpec.description: SimulationSpec is the specification of a Simulation.

auth.description:
Auth lists the credentials the simulator accepts. The way they are
checked follows the provider auth type.

basePath.description:
BasePath is the path prefix of the API (the path part of the provider
base URL). Routes are relative to it.

headers.description:
Headers added to every response, computed from the limit state:
"limit:<name>.max", "limit:<name>.remaining" or "limit:<name>.reset"
(seconds until the window resets).

inventory.description: Inventory generates synthetic items for templated fixtures.

portOffset.description:
PortOffset is the port of the simulator in tapyr sim --all, as an
offset from --listen-base, so that adding a package does not move the
others. Simulators without one take the ports after the largest
declared offset, in provider name order.

routes.description: Routes served by the simulator. Unknown routes return 404.

description: The simulator of a provider package (sim/sim.yaml).
title: Simulation
